# Current migration requirements (supersedes earlier migration text)

Authoritative user scope: the 8 original functions in /home/yangfp/crtos/Ubiquitous/XiZi_IIoT_Macro/kernel/thread/double_link.c and the 9 original functions in adjacent single_link.c. Use their exact function names. Historical rec/combination/callpoint cases are not independent targets. Preserve executable C, data/order semantics, insertion/deletion ownership transfer and removal reset-to-self postconditions.

Reference: crtosverify/master d215f73b69916cc5c7c01af752bca4b6f96b3530 lib/dll.v, frozen as dll.v beside this document. Compatibility takes priority over old local guards. Public reference DLL must provide the exact record type, constructor, projections, Arguments/notations, five spatial predicates and ALL reference lemma interfaces. Preserve argument order, implicit parameters, conditions, field ownership, recursive expansion and simpl/unfold behavior. No added nonnull/endpoint guards in canonical predicates. Logical equivalence alone is insufficient.

Two layouts must be supported explicitly. Reference Module DLL must retain literal DoubleLinklistType in field addresses. Local C uses SysDoubleLinklistNode; use a separately named local layout instance (XiziLocalDLL preferred). It MUST share DLL.DL_Node itself, with transparent aliases or shared-record functor; never introduce an independent local record requiring client conversions. Do not assume the field_address function ignores its string argument, and do not add field-layout equality axioms. All 8 local C specs should use the local layout instance and the shared node type. A library-side compatibility entry can later expose the appropriate instance as DLL to original imports. Reference Module DLL itself must remain usable at its original layout. Main agent will handle import fixtures and actual unchanged-proof compilation separately.

Use addr_nodes : list addr -> list (DLL.DL_Node unit), storeA := emp, and proved payload/address projection facts where applicable. Public list-addr specializations should be instances of reference recursion. Retain older guarded declarations only as clearly marked legacy/internal dependencies while consumers migrate; do not claim unconditional equivalence to them. API-specific pure premises require actual C justification and belong outside canonical predicates.

Original idmanager proof-body compilation is required in addition to all local cases. Local master contains only four library files and no VC proofs; origin/idnode has six proof families and a preexisting nonzero axiom absent from master. This ambiguity and preexisting assumption are tracked by main agent. DO NOT import or add that axiom to this clean common library. No new Admitted, Axiom, weakened theorem or forbidden lemma in maintained formal files. Reuse valid proof scripts and actually recompile under current definitions.

Canonical symexec must record actual driver, cwd, -IQCP_examples/QCP_demos_LLM/ and -slp QCP_examples/QCP_demos_LLM/ SimpleC.EE.QCP_demos_LLM plus common mapping. Coq feedback only via main-worktree coq_tooling.py check/debug. Root AGENTS.md governs controller-owned acceptance and fixed phase/group roles. Edit only handoff allowed paths; generated files only via symexec. Complete recoverable work inside the assigned attempt.
